why: The PQSS is a named self-report assessment instrument for measuring clinical-learning stressors, not a reusable instructional element.
name: Persian Questionnaire of Stressful Sources (PQSS)
product_description: The PQSS is a 29-item Persian-language questionnaire developed by Iranian researchers to measure sources of stress in clinical learning environments among nursing and midwifery students.

why: Physics quantitative literacy is a domain-specific construct and tentative psychometric framework from one study, not a general theory of learning or teaching.

The candidate applies the broader Conceptual Blending Theory to physics quantitative reasoning, while PIQL and its three facets are a domain-specific assessment rather than a distinct general learning theory.
